cohort_targets.setting_note: The question is whether an actively managed pathway run by our orchestrated arm reaches what a real integrated, actively managed programme achieves, so the orchestrated arm (not the baseline) is compared. cohort_targets.independence_note: B21: the fast booking lane (appointment.fast_lane_lead_median_days and _sigma) is calibrated to this workbook's 4- and 8-week shares (KPI 4), so the two band rows and the median (which the lognormal through the bands reproduces to 0.1 day) are IN-SAMPLE and not scored. cohort_targets.primary_variant: programme-managed (no forgotten steps, automatic referral, prompt booking)
cohort_targets.setting_note: Managed national programme: the programme issues the referral and owns follow-up. Adjusted variant removes the baseline's forgotten steps, referral rejection and unanswered referrals, and sets baseline.programme_managed (prompt booking, B21). The Scottish clock starts at the screening-test REFERRAL date (a few days to two weeks after the result), the simulator's at the result, which biases the comparison against the simulator on the timing rows.
